_comment: The T-0 gate of the experiment {{name}}: what must hold seconds before the trial.
Each entry is either a machine check ({text, check, args}) or a plain string the
operator confirms. A check is a script in the package's preflight/checks/ or in
this project's experiments/common/preflight/checks/ (same name wins). Its exit
code decides: 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 3 SKIP. A text starting with [HARD] cannot be
overridden by the operator. ${name} in an argument is filled from the trial's
factor values and launch arguments. Checks run after the stack is launched, so
they measure the real processes and topics of this trial.

checklist.text: [HARD] The DDS configuration is known and the kernel can give it the receive buffer it demands (net.core.rmem_max).
[HARD] Exactly this trial's talker is running: no leftover from a previous run.
[HARD] The bag directory is writable on the machine that records.

checklist: Operator: the stack and the recording are the ones this trial declares (a plain string is confirmed by the operator).
